author: CBR
description:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day recreated iconic Spider-Man comic covers by keeping enlarged copies of the original artwork beside the production monitors. Director Destin Daniel Cretton explains how the filmmakers matched the framing and poses as closely as possible, even when the illustrated body positions were nearly impossible to reproduce in live action.

The result is a series of shots designed to transition almost seamlessly between the classic Spider-Man artwork and its live-action recreation.
